purpose: A model-independent, one-time audit that may unseal BLIND runtime evidence only long enough to measure runtime-join coverage. It is not a P0 unlock and cannot create a performance outcome.

preconditions.required_pre_access_proof: The frozen formal-runtime membership hash above was recorded before candidate-level BLIND runtime-join inspection.

roles.blind_custodian: Performs the one allowed coverage join inside the sealed BLIND environment and releases only the prescribed aggregate receipt.
roles.independent_auditor: Checks the receipt hashes, fixed circuit set, and R07/R13 decision rules without receiving candidate-level BLIND records.
roles.model_or_tuning_operator: Must not receive BLIND records or use this audit for training, selection, calibration, or tuning.

one_shot_protocol.failure_action: Immediately reseal all BLIND artifacts; publish no partial candidate-level result; record only a failed aggregate receipt; do not retry under this contract.

allowed_receipt.aggregation: per blind circuit and method only; no candidate-level rows

R07.pass_when: For each of s9234, s38584, and wb_dma, every executed-stage action has exactly one runtime join: missing_runtime_join_count == 0, ambiguous_runtime_join_count == 0, and coverage_rate == 1.0.

R13.pass_when: R07 passes and, within each of s9234, s38584, and wb_dma, every audited method has the identical frozen runtime-eligible action-space hash, with no exclusion introduced after unseal.

decision_rules.p0: This receipt can inform a later runtime_recovery_gate assessment only. P0 remains BLOCKED until an independent assessment establishes every R01 through R14 as PASS.
